title: Forming a Delaware LLC: certificate, registered agent and the annual tax
rule: A Delaware LLC is formed when its certificate of formation, signed by an authorized person, is filed with the Secretary of State, or later if the certificate says so. The certificate gives the name, which must include "Limited Liability Company," "L.L.C." or "LLC," and the registered office and agent the LLC must keep in Delaware. The LLC owes a $400 annual tax each June 1; late payment adds a $200 penalty and 1.5% monthly interest and costs good standing.
